about.title: About the Paradox Rift set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Paradox Rift is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 3 November 2023. It has 266 cards: 182 in the main set and 84 secret rares. For a master set there are also 162 reverse holos, and 19 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 182 main set cards), the Complete set (all 266 cards), the Master set (428 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (447 cards, adding the 19 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
